scope: Finite actual npx option profile already promised in M02: --prefix requires its real value and --no-install preserves execution; help/version modes execute no Vitest and unknown/incomplete forms claim no credit. No general parser requirement.

cases.workflow:
jobs:
  test:
    steps:
      - run: npx --prefix packages/core --help vitest run skills/

jobs:
  test:
    steps:
      - run: npx --prefix packages/core --version vitest run skills/

jobs:
  test:
    steps:
      - run: npx --prefix --help vitest run skills/

jobs:
  test:
    steps:
      - run: npx --prefix packages/core vitest run packages/core/skills/

jobs:
  test:
    steps:
      - run: npx --prefix packages/core --no-install vitest run packages/core/skills/
